# TerrainBuffers

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/renderer/terrain/`](../folders/src-renderer-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/renderer/terrain/terrain_sys.h`](../../../src/renderer/terrain/terrain_sys.h)

## Summary

Context variable exposing TerrainSys's indirect draw buffer and per-slot vertex buffers to the terrain and grass passes.

## Description

Emplaced by TerrainSys::init (indirect and indirect_stride set there; vertices empty). TerrainSys::allocateSlot appends the vertex buffer of each newly created slot, so vertices.size() equals the number of slots ever allocated and is indexed by ChunkGPU::slot. Handles are non-owning copies: the VmaBuffers live in TerrainSys. indirect holds max_slots (2048) vk::DrawIndirectCommand entries at indirect_stride (sizeof(DrawIndirectCommand) = 16 rounded up to max(minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment, 16)). Each vertex buffer holds max_triangles * 3 = 98304 TerrainVertex (32 bytes). Erased by TerrainSys's destructor. The passes use reg.ctx().find and skip drawing when it is absent (scene without the Terrain system).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `indirect` | `vk::Buffer` | null handle | Indirect draw commands, one per slot (storage \| indirect \| transfer dst, GPU only). |
| `indirect_stride` | `vk::DeviceSize` | 0 | Byte stride between slots in indirect. |
| `vertices` | `std::vector<vk::Buffer>` | empty | Vertex buffer of each slot, indexed by ChunkGPU::slot. |
